title: Historical briefings cut off in the early 2010s

tellings.quote: there was an initiative in the early 2010s to cut off historical briefings on new on new program incumbents.

plain: In the early 2010s, there was a push to stop giving the full history of a programme to the new people who took it over, so newcomers would no longer hear about what came before them. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb says this on the podcast, passing on what a source told him, and places it around MITRE, a nonprofit that runs research for the US government. If true, it would explain how knowledge of secret UFO work could fade even inside the government.
